comment: Archives packed into the APK as assets/components/<file> (stored, not recompressed) and unpacked on first start. Gradle (bundleComponents) copies them from -PcomponentsDir (default /var/tmp/panvk/components) and fails on any sha256 mismatch. Fetched: scripts/fetch-launcher-components.sh. Built: scripts/build-fex-windows.sh, scripts/build-dxvk.sh (pins in scripts/components.env). -PbundleComponents=false builds a download-only APK.
